## 🌊 Atlantic Niño

The dominant mode of interannual variability in the equatorial Atlantic Ocean, influencing rainfall over West Africa and South America.

**Topics**

- SST anomalies
- Atlantic Zonal Mode
- Teleconnections

[Explore →](atlantic_nino.qmd)

</div>

<div class="research-card">

## 🌧 West African Monsoon

A complex coupled ocean–atmosphere system controlling rainfall across the Sahel and Guinea Coast.

**Topics**

- Seasonal rainfall
- Monsoon dynamics
- Climate variability

[Explore →](west_african_monsoon.qmd)

</div>

## 🌎 El Niño–Southern Oscillation

The leading mode of tropical Pacific climate variability with worldwide impacts on weather and climate.

**Topics**

- ENSO
- Teleconnections
- Seasonal prediction

[Explore →](enso.qmd)
